name: Dashboard
descriptor: Two or more lists, a switcher between them, and a strip of metric cards over all of them.
verify_checks: dashboard: the metric maths is emitted
pros: two lists in one file, which most small tools actually need
the cards answer the first question before any list is read
each list keeps its own fields and its own form
one storage key, one export, one backup
cons: no relation between the lists: a task cannot point at a project
the cards are computed over every row, not over a chosen period
four metrics is the sensible maximum before the strip wraps
one list is visible at a time; there is no combined view
best_for: two related lists and a question about their totals
avoid_if: the lists need to reference each other
